summary: Judge0 CE provides a backend API that compiles and executes source code in various programming languages. It is typically used to build online code editors, coding assessment platforms, and educational coding environments. The service processes untrusted code submissions in an isolated environment.
goodFor: Developers building coding challenge websites, technical interview platforms, or automated grading systems that require remote code execution.
watchOut: Running arbitrary user code presents inherent security risks regarding isolation, resource exhaustion, and potential sandbox escapes. Additionally, the maintenance activity for this project has slowed down recently.
deployNotes: You will typically deploy this via Docker using container orchestration alongside a database and a caching layer. Ensure you configure proper resource limits and network isolation to prevent runaway code executions from impacting your host server.
